description: Registry of every root package.json override and every accepted dev-scope npm-audit advisory, plus (under "seeds", keyed by lockfile path) every override and accepted advisory of each other tracked lockfile, which the root overrides and the production audit gate never reach (SMI-6954, ADR-176 section 6), with reason, provenance, removal condition (removeWhen, recorded prose that people re-read; Check 76 requires it to be present and non-empty and never evaluates it) and expiry. Every override and every accepted advisory must have an entry here. audit:standards Check 76 enforces it (SMI-6949, ADR-176): override keys and pins must match package.json, and an acceptance fails CI on and after its expiry date. dependency-registry-expiry.yml re-runs the check daily, since Check 76 otherwise runs only on code PRs, and keeps one GitHub issue open while an acceptance is failing or within its 14-day warn window, and also runs check-dependency-registry.mjs --reconcile-audit against npm audit output (an acceptance absent from the report, for the wrong package or with the wrong severity, or an advisory with no acceptance, fails, unless an install npm reports as affected by it (the report's nodes, looked up in package-lock.json) is a production install: that one is informational and left to the production audit gate, which fails only at high or above, so below-high production advisories are reported by the job and enforced by no gate, and affected installs that cannot be determined fail closed). Every tracked lockfile other than the root needs a "seeds" entry; a seed acceptance has scope "seed" and tier R3, or R4 with pinnedBy; the daily job audits each seed inside its own directory and fails on every unaccepted seed advisory, at any severity and install scope, because no other blocking gate or scheduled npm audit job evaluates the standing seed tree (Dependency Guard checks only a PR's added or changed seed dependencies, at high or above; Dependabot alerts cover it but do not block).
